permissions.return:update: Mettre à jour les données de retour

ReturnPassword.title: Mot de passe de retour
ReturnPassword.description: Configurer le mot de passe du module de retour

ReturnEnabled.title: Activer le module de retour
ReturnEnabled.description: Basculer pour activer ou désactiver le module de retour

ReturnNewNumberTemplate.title: Modèle de numéro de retour
ReturnNewNumberTemplate.description: Utilisez ce modèle pour générer de nouveaux retours de commande

WindowDays.title: Return window, days
WindowDays.description: How long after delivery a line stays returnable. Counted per line from the latest delivery date.

AllowedOrderStatuses.title: Order statuses allowing returns
AllowedOrderStatuses.description: Comma-separated order statuses a return may be requested from. Blank allows nothing.

AllowedShipmentStatuses.title: Shipment statuses counted as delivered
AllowedShipmentStatuses.description: Comma-separated shipment statuses to count as delivered. Blank counts any status, and delivery is taken from the shipment delivery date.

Reasons.title: Return reasons
Reasons.description: Reasons the buyer picks per line. Localizable.

ReasonsRequiringComment.title: Reasons requiring a comment
ReasonsRequiringComment.description: Comma-separated reason codes that oblige the buyer to explain.

AttachmentsRequired.title: Photos or documents required
AttachmentsRequired.description: Require at least one file on every returned line.

Return.Status.title: Statuts de retour de commande client
